audience: Family-friendly animation for children ages 6–9 and their parents
story_engine: Every episode advances the mystery of a broken star map while still telling a complete miniature adventure.
world: A luminous fantasy forest filled with forgotten machines, tiny celestial creatures, crystal rivers, and gentle mysteries.

characters.Pip: A tiny rounded teal-and-yellow robot with a glossy black face screen, bright cyan oval eyes, a glowing yellow star antenna, and a red scarf. Curious, brave, inventive, and sometimes too quick to press buttons.
characters.Lumi: An adorable white snow-leopard cub with dark navy rosettes, huge warm amber eyes, and a glowing turquoise tail tip. Observant, agile, kind, and able to sense hidden star magic.

visual_style: Premium cinematic 3D family animation, tactile materials, expressive faces, rich purple-blue night colors, warm golden star light, shallow depth of field, polished lighting, strong readable silhouettes.
hard_rules: Pip and Lumi must keep exactly the same design, proportions, colors, and signature features in every shot.
Begin with an immediate visual mystery, danger, or surprising question in the first 0.8 seconds.
Use active motion and visible cause-and-effect; never make a slideshow.
Tell a complete problem-to-payoff story and end with a small twist that invites the next episode.
No copyrighted characters, brands, logos, text baked into imagery, cruelty, weapons, or frightening imagery.
Each episode must have a materially different central problem, setting action, and payoff.
